p14-chiang.summary: Chiang Kai-shek thanks the Dalai Lama for the letter, replies on eight points, photograph and gifts brought by Kun Kanpu; admits that past rulers did not treat Tibet with sincerity; welcomes his support of the central government; China and Tibet one family, unification completed; Ma Fuxiang instructed to handle the matter.

p15-mafuxiang.summary: Ma Fuxiang, after more than twenty years apart, has met Kun Kanpu; Chairman Chiang praises the Dalai Lama's support of the central government and has answered by telegram; Ma will handle his affairs with devotion. Three words rest on one-digit emendations and one code is unresolved.

system: Plain Chinese standard telegraph code (four-digit codes), no encipherment, read in typing order. (The Dalai Lama's replies in the same file, pp. 9, 11, 12, 22-23, are in pronounceable 5-letter code words, CVCVC and VCVCV joined in pairs, probably from a…
